who.value: services seller and the buyer who requested the quote

stage.value: after the quote is sent, follow-up

job.value: seller sends one follow-up; buyer reviews the quote in chat

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The seller's 'Quoted · Buyer viewed your quote' and the buyer's 'You got a quote from this seller' make each screen's purpose clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The red 'Send a follow-up' on the seller side and the 'Can I book a site visit?' reply on the buyer side stand out.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Send a follow-up' doesn't say what the follow-up will ask, though the seller picks its intent next.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Estimated price range', 'Notes to buyer' and 'Message this seller' are plain.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Sending one nudge and replying to a quote are decisions each side can make.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Request details and Quote details are split into tabs; the buyer's full quote sits behind 'View details'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Each phone shows only what that person needs at this step.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The quote's range and four short bullets carry it; the seller's footer line is a single sentence.
